# Tomasella and Hodnett (1998), point-retention regressions for Amazonian soils.

## Source

Tomasella, J., & Hodnett, M. G. (1998). Estimating soil water retention characteristics from limited data in Brazilian Amazonia. Soil Science, 163(3), 190-202.

[DOI: 10.1097/00010694-199803000-00003](https://doi.org/10.1097/00010694-199803000-00003)

## Scope

**Territory:** Brazilian Amazonia

**Dataset:** Pooled literature data for 614 soil horizons from 10 Amazonian sites; the number of observations available differed among regressions.

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_tomasella1998`

Estimate porosity and water contents at eight matric potentials.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Porosity and volumetric water content at matric potentials from -1 to -1500 kPa.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — Eight point-specific multiple linear regressions

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organic_carbon` | `number` | % | — | Soil organic carbon content by mass. |
| `silt` | `number` | % | 0.9 <= value <= 71 | Silt content by mass for particles from 0.05 to 0.002 mm. |
| `clay` | `number` | % | 3 <= value <= 96 | Clay content by mass for particles smaller than 0.002 mm. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `porosity` | % | — | Total soil porosity expressed as a volume percentage. |
| `theta_1` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -1 kPa matric potential. |
| `theta_3` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -3 kPa matric potential. |
| `theta_6` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -6 kPa matric potential. |
| `theta_10` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -10 kPa matric potential. |
| `theta_33` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -33 kPa matric potential. |
| `theta_100` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -100 kPa matric potential. |
| `theta_500` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -500 kPa matric potential. |
| `theta_1500` | % | — | Volumetric water content at -1500 kPa matric potential. |

!!! note

    Sand is omitted because its percentage is a linear combination of silt and clay.

!!! note

    Silt and clay percentages must sum to no more than 100.

!!! note

    The structured input ranges are the intersection of the source's Table 3 ranges for the nine returned regressions. The paper does not report an organic-carbon calibration range.

!!! warning

    The porosity regression has the lowest reported correlation and the paper identifies bulk density as an important omitted predictor.

!!! warning

    The regressions are less reliable near saturation and the calibration data did not include plinthitic soils.
